# `ironwood.util.zip`

**Package reference**

Checksums for compressed formats. This first slice provides only [`CRC32`](CRC32.md); the
`Checksum` interface, buffer updates and the ZIP and GZIP stream APIs are not yet
part of the library.

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`CRC32`](CRC32.md) | class | Computes the CRC-32 checksum of a byte stream: the checksum that ZIP entries and GZIP members record for their uncompressed bytes (reflected polynomial `0xEDB88320`, initial and final value `0xFFFFFFFF`). |
